name.value: Camperland Bridal Falls RV Resort & Cabins

description.value: A large, full-service RV resort at the base of Mt. Cheam in the Fraser Valley, directly off the Trans-Canada Highway and steps from Bridal Veil Falls Provincial Park; amenities run to heated pools, hot tubs, playgrounds, and an on-site store, though the focus is firmly on RVs and cabins rather than tent camping.
